lines.en: My robe hem sweeps the flagstones
Short steps, but I have grand plans
I steady myself on the wall and shuffle on

lines.zh: 这座塔的每一层我都熟
lines.en: I know every floor of this tower

lines.zh: 我走过的地方都留着回声
lines.en: Echoes trail behind wherever I walk
My head is too big, so I walk carefully
I climb the stairs counting each one

lines.zh: 我的影子比本人大得多
lines.en: My shadow is far bigger than I am
I walk and plan the next move
My sleeves are too long, they drag

lines.zh: 这一层空气闷，我不喜欢
lines.en: The air on this floor is stale, I dislike it
I stop only when I reach the door
My staff tip taps the floor
I have walked this path for many years
I stand still, and my eyes keep turning

lines.zh: 我在想一个很久的计划
lines.en: I am considering a very old plan

lines.zh: 手指在袖子里数着什么
lines.en: My fingers count something inside my sleeve
This body holds only a hundred points
I am in no hurry to act
The lamp flame wavers once
You will understand once I finish speaking
My smile is not a friendly one

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的听众
lines.en: I am waiting for a suitable audience

lines.zh: 这塔里静得能听见灰落
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear dust settle
I stroke my chin
A plan is worth more than strength
I hum a small incantation

lines.zh: 站着的时间我从不浪费
lines.en: I never waste time standing around
You came, and I calculated it already
Do not fear, I do not bite
Come closer, let me look at you
Your ki is weak, but there is potential
I can teach you, or use you

lines.zh: 你眼睛在躲，说明你没底
lines.en: Your eyes avoid mine, so you lack confidence
Some skills are harder than fists
You had better remember what I say
Stand straight, your master is speaking

lines.zh: 你的身体在发抖，很正常
lines.en: Your body trembles, that is normal
To grow strong, you must follow me
Avoid my face and you will regret it
Let us discuss your future
I am not your enemy, for now
Say what you wish to learn

lines.zh: 一次对话，比一场战斗更值
lines.en: One conversation is worth more than a fight
You dare raise a hand to me
These robes were old already.
I have entered that in the ledger

lines.zh: 老骨头也会疼，扶我一把。
lines.en: Old bones ache too; give me a hand.

lines.zh: 我咳了两声，把血咽回去。
lines.en: I cough twice and swallow the blood back.
Students who hit their master are rare

lines.zh: 脸上挨了一下，我笑得发冷。
lines.en: A blow lands on my face; my smile turns cold.
This wound for leverage over you is fair
I laugh, and it sounds cold

lines.zh: 等我讲完课，再算这笔账
lines.en: We settle this after the lesson

lines.zh: 这东西放桌上，别递给我
lines.en: Leave it on the table, do not hand it to me
I do not lack food, I lack obedience
I accept the gift, now hear my terms

lines.zh: 这东西想换我的课？先说条件。
lines.en: You want to trade this for my lesson? Name your terms.
Set it down first, then speak slowly
That will not move me
Taking this much does no harm
Your intentions are written on your face

lines.zh: 我不吃，但可以用来试验
lines.en: I will not eat it, but it could be tested
A master never takes a gift for free
You bumped into me, be careful
These old bones do not take impacts well
I steady my hat
Step back, you are in my way
I raise a hand and you retreat
That counts as rudeness
I am not a boulder
Do not think I forget grudges

lines.zh: 你比我高出许多，可我不怕
lines.en: You tower over me, and I am not afraid
Watch where you walk next time
At my age, I speak only of plans

lines.zh: 同行者要有用，最好能打
lines.en: A companion must be useful, ideally strong
I choose helpers sparingly
Working together starts with rules
Two in one tower is company enough
I trust only those who are useful
Before cooperating, study the other

lines.zh: 我有太多事要做，需要人手
lines.en: I have too much to do and need hands
A partner still takes my orders

lines.zh: 这条路上，我一个人太慢
lines.en: On this road, alone I am too slow
I lift it with the tip of my staff
This weight is barely manageable
I catch it in my sleeve
Dropping things shows you are unsteady
This thing might be useful
I look it over and tuck it away
Do not reach, I will take it

lines.zh: 收了它，就当欠我个人情
lines.en: Taking it means you owe me a favor
The thing is mine, the reason is yours

lines.zh: 我笑起来时，通常没好事
lines.en: When I smile, it rarely means well
Those I set my eyes on do not escape
The spot you stand on will do
This look is not kindness
You carry something I want
I raise a hand and point at you
The next step of the plan is you
I laugh once, briefly

lines.zh: 别急着走，我们还没谈完
lines.en: Do not rush off, we are not finished
I have remembered your name
You cannot escape this
I keep watching you, patiently

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的眼光跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, my gaze follows

lines.zh: 别以为转身就看不见我
lines.en: Turning away does not hide you from me
I am waiting for your guard to drop

lines.zh: 这塔里没有我不知道的角落
lines.en: There is no corner of this tower I do not know
I murmur half an incantation
No need to fear, it is not time yet
I can tell your footsteps apart
Take your time, I am in no hurry
In this game, I move the pieces
I rap you with my staff
Old bones can still strike
This blow is light, a reminder
A push of my hand sends you back
There is something hidden in my sleeve
Do not make me get serious
I have little strength, but it is precise
Hitting you hurts my hand too
That move was taught by a master
Step back, then we talk again

lines.zh: 我在这座塔里等很久了
lines.en: I have waited in this tower a long time
A shadow appears on the stairs
I was not spawned by nature
Someone placed me here
The wind from the top reaches me first
I smooth my robe
The lamp is lit, so I should speak

lines.zh: 这座建筑就是我的位置
lines.en: This structure is my place
A hundred points of body is enough

lines.zh: 我在等一个愿意听的人
lines.en: I am waiting for someone willing to listen
Flame catches my sleeve
I slid down the stairs

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脸，我呛住了
lines.en: Water covers my face and I choke

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过石板，全是灰。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the flagstones, all dust.
An arrow sticks in my robe
That magic bites harder than mine
I cannot lecture on an empty stomach

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我头发都竖了
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my hair stands up

lines.zh: 虚空里没有塔，没有台阶
lines.en: In the void there is no tower, no stairs
